Run Wyvern for stakes, not flavor.

GMs: Remind them the Wyvern's stinger is DC 15 CON; ignoring it makes their healer's life a nightmare.

Fire Resistance is often underestimated for its duration - 1 turn or more can change the course of a battle.

Judges: Cast Fire Resistance before the flames start licking, using its 1-turn duration to shield the party from predictable fire hazards.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Scimitar's versatility often goes unnoticed - Finesse lets you use STR or DEX.

GMs: Remind players to leverage the Scimitar's Finesse property using Dexterity for better odds against high AC foes.

Put Spectator in terrain with one strong feature and start a visible clock - every delay should make positioning and objective pressure worse.

DMs: Inform players that the Spectator's darkvision of 120 feet means they're already in its sights, so act quickly.

Judges: Exploit Festhaken's 25% magic resistance and dimensional jaunt to negate spells and ambush isolated targets.

Backstab damage stacks higher than most expect - an extra weapon die plus additional dice equal to half.

GMs: Remind players that Backstab adds one weapon die plus half-level dice, rounded down, to avoid damage disputes.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

GMs: Remind Seers to use Destined's 1d6 bonus when a DC 9 Wisdom check succeeds, shifting from support to pressure.

DMs: Cast Detect Poison and Disease as a ritual before entering unknown areas to reveal threats without wasting a spell slot.
